settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Manage your account, preferences, and workspace configuration.
settings.profileDesc: Manage your personal information and public identity.
settings.workspaceDesc: Configure your workspace appearance and language preferences.
settings.notificationsDesc: Choose how and when you want to be notified.
settings.emailNotificationsDesc: Receive updates and alerts via email.
settings.pushNotificationsDesc: Browser push alerts for real-time activity.
settings.weeklyReportsDesc: Get a digest of your team's performance every Monday.
settings.aiDesc: Monitor your AI copilot usage and configuration.
settings.aiModelDesc: Using GPT-5-mini and GPT-4o-mini models for intelligent project planning.
settings.securityDesc: Manage your account protection, active devices, and sign-in methods.
settings.twoFactorActiveDesc: Two-step verification is enabled. Your account is protected by an additional layer of security.
settings.twoFactorInactiveDesc: Add an extra layer of protection to your account with 2FA.
settings.passwordManagementDesc: Keep your password strong. We recommend updating it every 90 days.
settings.passwordMinLength: New password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.dangerZoneDesc: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
settings.deleteWarn1: All your projects and tasks will be deleted
settings.deleteWarn2: Your team memberships will be removed
settings.deleteWarn3: This action is permanent and irreversible
settings.billingDesc: Manage your subscription, payment methods, and invoices.
settings.activityDesc: A record of all important actions performed in your account.

dashboard.title: Workspace Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Monitor your ongoing project velocity, active milestones, and workspace telemetries.
dashboard.telemetryDesc: Orchest provides live system telemetry. You can track performance charts, design systems syncs, and AI task distributions in real time with our automated widgets.

wizard.title: Create New Project
wizard.subtitle: How would you like to create your project?
wizard.aiDesc: Let AI help you structure your project with intelligent suggestions and automated planning.
wizard.manualDesc: Build your project from scratch with full control over every detail and timeline.
wizard.typeSubtitle: Will you be working alone or with a team?
wizard.teamDesc: Collaborate with team members, assign roles, and track collective progress.
wizard.individualDesc: Work independently on your project with personal task management and tracking.

projects.workspaceProjectsDesc: Manage your project lifecycles, track phase progress, and coordinate delivery.
projects.failedLoadDesc: There was an error loading your projects. Please try again.
projects.noProjectsDesc: Create your first project to get started with task tracking and team collaboration.
